title: Big Feelings (Announcement)
caption:
Every kid runs into moments bigger than they are. A missed shot, the night before a new school, a friend who suddenly goes quiet. 💛

The McCray Learning Lab turns those moments into short, warm story-comics kids can play through on their own or right beside a grown-up. A friendly voice reads every word out loud, and, one calm choice at a time, they rehearse the skill for real life.

25 stories. Read aloud. Six free forever, no account needed.
▶️ Start free: mccraylearninglab.com (IG: link in bio)

title: Gameplay Reel — Keep the Love
caption:

title: Launch Reel — Three New Stories (EN)
caption:

title: Spotlight — Keep the Love (Micah)
caption:
When Micah's dog Biscuit dies, the water bowl by the door is still full. 💛

Keep the Love is a gentle story about grief. Auntie Nia doesn't try to make the sad go away. She shows Micah something truer: love doesn't leave. We learn to carry it.

A tender read-aloud for ages 6-12, part of the Lab membership. Start with the six free stories and see if the Lab is your family's kind of place.
▶️ mccraylearninglab.com (IG: link in bio)
notes: Baked-in image hook: "When Micah's dog dies, he learns that love doesn't leave. We learn to carry it."

A growth-mindset comic for ages 10-16. Read aloud, and free forever.
